document.abstract: This paper is a summary of key items which were contained in a prospectus for an electronic cinematography (EC) camera, written by CBS, to provide guidance for interested camera manufacturers. The intention of the prospectus is to highlight areas for consideration in the design of a TV camera optimized for single camera cinematography, rather than to provide specific circuitry details.
